title: Grateful Dead Live at Clark University on 1969-04-20

ai_review.summary: Outstanding 1969 sound quality captures a fire‑filled Dark Star and the early Dead’s psychedelic magic
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear audio for a 1969 performance, calling it “outstanding” and noting Jerry Garcia’s guitar is on fire throughout. The show is praised as an inspiring, trippy experience with Dark Star highlighted as a brilliant centerpiece.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews award 5 stars and consistently praise both the musical performance (especially Jerry’s playing and Dark Star) and the exceptional recording quality, indicating a top‑tier show with excellent sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as outstanding for any year, noting clear capture of instruments and Jerry’s tone; no mention of noise or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is portrayed as an inspiring, continuous psychedelic journey with a strong focus on Dark Star.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised – “on fire”, great tone, inspirational playing.
